rules.title: Jinja2 template string from variable
rules.message: Rendering attacker-influenced templates enables SSTI → RCE.
rules.fix: Never render user-controlled template source; use fixed templates + autoescape.

rules.title: Flask render_template_string
rules.message: render_template_string is an SSTI sink if any part of the template is user-controlled.
rules.fix: Use render_template with static files only.

rules.title: Pug/Jade compile with dynamic input
rules.message: Compiling templates from request data can lead to SSTI/RCE.
